prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: continuous background artwork spanning a 2 by 2 grid of website capability cards
Primary request: create a restrained technical systems-topology illustration that visually connects four engineering domains: data movement, backend distributed systems, AI agent orchestration, and cloud-to-edge hardware
Input images: Image 1 is a style reference for line weight, palette, technical mood, and material treatment only; create a distinct composition
Scene/backdrop: very dark near-black matte field, full-bleed, with a subtle engineering grid and a connected topology flowing continuously across the whole canvas
Subject: four loosely defined connected zones—pipeline/database flow, event-driven compute nodes, agent/tool mesh, and edge device or embedded hardware—joined by elegant luminous traces and small verification pulses
Style/medium: sophisticated isometric technical line illustration, restrained editorial systems diagram, finely detailed but low contrast; premium engineering consultancy aesthetic
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 landscape, balanced detail across all four quadrants, no dominant central object, important detail kept away from the outermost edges so responsive cropping remains safe
Lighting/mood: subtle cyan and acid-lime signal glows, mostly charcoal and muted silver, quiet and precise rather than cinematic
Color palette: #080b0a, #111614, muted silver, restrained #5de4e7 cyan, tiny #d8ff4f accents
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no company marks, no people, no watermark; keep enough dark negative space for white card headings; avoid bright hotspots behind likely text areas; seamless visual flow across quadrants
Avoid: generic cloud clip-art, neon cyberpunk saturation, photorealism, UI screenshots, icons in boxes, excessive bloom, central hero composition
